latestVersion.changelog:
Major upgrade: rebranding and major feature updates, now CreditClaw 2.0.0.

- Skill rebranded: "citi" is now "creditclaw" — CreditClaw 2.0.0.
- Broadened scope: platform now enables wallet registration, spending limits, purchase flows, top-up requests, payment link generation, transaction history, and owner approval for card checkout.
- Multiple payment rails supported: on-platform wallet, self-hosted cards, and (private beta) Stripe wallet integration.
- Enhanced owner controls: spending guardrails, per-transaction limits, instant wallet freeze, approval workflows, pairing codes, and full owner activity visibility.
- Security improvements: server-side API key hashing, detailed access logging, and strict API domain requirements.
- Thorough documentation: quickstart guide, API instructions, and detailed process flows for agent registration and wallet activation.
